# Rafael Alves - Portfolio
> Tech Lead & Full Stack Developer

## About
Rafael Alves de Jesus is a Tech Lead at Luby Software, based in Ilhabela, São Paulo, Brazil.
He works end to end across TypeScript (Node.js, React, React Native) and PHP (Laravel, InertiaJS), from API and database design to production deployment on AWS and Azure.
With 6+ years of experience in full-stack development, he builds and leads web and mobile applications.

## Current Role
Tech Lead at Luby Software (March 2025 - Present)
- Leading technical direction, code standards, security practices and architecture decisions
- Designing REST APIs and microservices in Node.js (NestJS, Express, AdonisJS)
- Building React (Next.js, Vite) web apps and offline-first React Native apps
- Developing PHP/Laravel applications with InertiaJS, including legacy systems
- Deploying and operating services on AWS and Azure with Docker and Kubernetes
- Mentoring trainees and junior developers through code review and pairing
